Fig. 2: The architecture of the SimpleST, which consists of three key components: spatio-temporal data, a prompt-tuning neural network, a TCN, and pre-trained GNN-based models. Within the spatio-temporal graph, white nodes indicate masked nodes, and their corresponding embedding vectors are labeled as "mask" in the figure. For the input spatio-temporal data, two distinct settings are illustrated. In Xpre, the blue node represents the center point, while the surrounding dark grey nodes are its neighbors. Conversely, in X tun, the dark grey node denotes the center point, and the surrounding blue nodes serve as neighbors. The embedding vectors corresponding to these nodes are marked using the same color scheme, blue or dark grey, to reflect their respective roles.
